sn1.27:1.1: The “stream” (here _sara_, otherwise _sota_) is usually explained as craving ([sn41.5:5.10](), [iti109:3.3]()). Or else it could be the “stream of lives” (_bhavasota_) as in the next sutta ([sn1.28:2.2]()).
sn1.27:1.2: The “cycle” of transmigration (_saṁsāra_) through endless rebirths (see [dn15:22.6](), [mn22:42.2]()). | The “streams” and the “cycle” also occur together in [ud7.2:4.1]().
sn1.27:2.2: The commentary says this is Nibbāna.
sn1.27:2.6: Passages such as [snp5.2:6.3](), [dn15:22.6]() and [dn11:85.26}() say that consciousness ceases at this point, too.
